title: The Ice Machine
hook: The desert motel clerk gave us one rule: if someone knocks with a full bucket of ice after midnight... don't let them in.
lines: On a road trip west, my sister and I stopped at a tiny motel in the middle of the desert.
The night clerk handed us a key, an empty ice bucket... and one rule.
If you hear the ice machine running after midnight... don't go out for ice.
And if someone knocks with a full bucket... don't let them in.
We laughed about it over vending machine snacks, then turned out the lights.
At two a.m., a low, grinding hum woke me up. The ice machine.
"Hey, it's me. Open up... I got us ice."
It was my sister's voice. Right outside the door.
I almost got up. Then I looked over at the other bed.
My sister was right there... curled up, facing the wall.
So I lay still, until the knocking finally stopped.
In the morning, a bucket of ice sat outside our door... melting in the sun.
Then the girl in my sister's bed rolled over, smiled... and whispered, "Thanks for not letting her in."
